description: Phase-fix ledger for the WaggleDance orchestrator review pipeline. Tag-IDs (ARCH-NNN, REL-NNN, SEC-NNN) are NOT globally unique -- each review run numbers its own findings from 0. The unique key is (phase_introduced, tag). Anchors use 'path :: stable_text' so they survive line-number drift.

rows.title: Cross-vendor multi-LLM lane: orchestrator-only, no browser automation in Phase 2B
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. The cross-vendor lane is implemented as 7 PowerShell modules driven manually by an operator pasting bundles into chat UIs. End-to-end synthetic dry-run lives at orchestrator/Run-Phase2BEndToEndDryRun.ps1; the report is written to docs/runs/orchestrator_phase2b_cross_vendor_2026_05_06/e2e_dry_run.md.

rows.title: Epoch evidence bundler: cumulative N-iteration evidence with 20-attachment cap
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Build-WaggleEpochEvidence computes a deterministic evidence_sha256 over the canonical sorted file list; the per-provider attachment plan enforces the 20-file cap (consolidates iter*_logs and iter*_internal_review when needed); all redacted via Invoke-WaggleRedaction.

rows.title: Provider profile abstraction: Claude Web / Gemini / Grok / GPT synthesis as configurable profiles
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. ProviderProfiles.ps1 default-fills four provider profiles (claude_web, gemini, grok, gpt_synthesis). Each carries enabled/timeout_sec/expected_model_in_ui. Disabled providers produce ok=false bundles instead of errors so the operator sees the gap.

rows.title: SHA-binding gate: source_evidence_sha256 is enforced at reviewer import, synthesis import, and iteration launch
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Three-way SHA agreement is enforced: the bundler stamps evidence_sha256 in epoch_evidence.json; reviewer + synthesizer responses must echo the same value; the iteration launcher recomputes from disk and refuses on mismatch. SHA-mismatch is exercised in tests at all three boundaries.

rows.title: HALT marker: synthesis can decide work is complete; orchestrator stops cleanly
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. decision=halt writes HALT.md with the synthesis_summary; trigger library returns decision=halt when the marker is present; iteration launcher refuses on non-continue decisions. The trigger library prioritizes pause > halt > early-trigger > cumulative.

rows.title: External response redaction: imported reviewer outputs run through redactor before storage
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B P17. Both reviewer and synthesis importers apply Invoke-WaggleRedaction to the entire response BEFORE storing it. Synthetic GitHub PAT in test fixtures is redacted before disk write; synthetic prompt-injection lines are preserved verbatim but inert (they are stored markdown, not executed).

rows.title: Drop claude_web from default external-review providers; Claude perspective comes from Phase 2A-2 internal review
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. Default external_review.providers contains gemini, grok, gpt_synthesis. Default Export-WaggleExternalReviewQueue invocation writes 2 bundles (gemini + grok). Explicit -Providers @('claude_web', ...) still works for legacy / second-opinion mode (asserted by 'arch-010 legacy' test case). claude_web.md retains a deprecation note pointing at Phase 2A-2 internal review for the Claude perspective.

rows.title: Operator Cockpit: passive HTML UI for the manual web-UI step
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. review_cockpit.html is single-file (embedded JS+CSS), polls state/cockpit_data.json every 5 seconds, restricts external origins to a whitelist (gemini.google.com, grok.com, chatgpt.com, claude.ai), and uses navigator.clipboard.writeText for copy actions. No browser automation. Test-CockpitData.ps1 has a known local PS 5.1 process-spawning hang and is intentionally not yet in the gate driver; Build-WaggleCockpitData itself is exercised by the Phase 2B-R end-to-end synthetic dry-run (P11).

rows.title: Codex Scout integration scaffold (no Codex execution required)
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. Import-WaggleCodexFindings applies Phase 2A-1 redactor BEFORE parsing, schema-validates, cross-checks scope.epoch_id, and writes per-import + a stable findings.json that Build-WaggleProposalMatrix consumes. The orchestrator does NOT install or run Codex; the operator runs Codex in a disposable git worktree per codex_setup.md and copies the result into the main project.

rows.title: Proposal Matrix builder: single decision surface aggregating internal + Codex + external proposals
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. Build-WaggleProposalMatrix discovers iterations from epoch_evidence.json, reads internal Claude reviews (Phase 2A-2) + optional codex findings + optional latest valid external imports per (provider, role), populates linked_ledger_tags from text matches against the committed phase_fix_ledger.json, and populates linked_regressions from finding-id matches against state/regression_ledger.json. Outputs proposal_matrix.json + proposal_matrix.md (grouped by category). The synthesis paste-block (P9) inlines this as the primary decision surface.

rows.title: Regression Ledger with severity scoring (0-100), trajectory, status state machine
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. RegressionLedger.ps1 exposes Get/Save (atomic .tmp + rename) / Add (auto REG-<UTC-date>-<NNN> id) / Update (legal-transition enforcement) / Get-Score (rubric: hardening_gate_failure=40, ci_failure=30, previously_passing_test_now_failing=25, runtime_crash=20, lock_state_signal=15, security_redaction=15, no_work_stall=10, source_supplement_sparse=10, doc_report_mismatch=5, cap 100) / Format-Excerpt (markdown for synthesis) / Write-Markdown (rendered file). Auto-update hook on hardening_gate_failure dedups by signature and is non-fatal.

rows.title: Dynamic epoch controller with verification gate, repair-attempt limits, severity-driven iteration ceiling
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. EpochCycleTrigger now supports min=2 / target=3 / max=6 (hard ceiling), 8 decision states (continue / continue_for_repair / continue_for_verification / continue_for_auto_repair / trigger / strategic_external_review / halt / pause / needs_manual_action), repair caps medium=2/high=2/critical=1, same-issue resurrection escalation, same-test-failed-twice escalation, severity-cap (>=80 -> remaining=current+1, >=60 -> current+2), full audit record + Save-WaggleEpochControllerDecision, and a verification-iteration prefix builder. Test-EpochCycleTrigger covers ~58 cases across all branches.

rows.title: Auto-repair classifier + constrained repair prompt builder
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. FindingClassifier returns one of {TRIVIAL_AUTO_FIX, LOCAL_REPAIR, EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, NEEDS_MANUAL_ACTION} via a fixability heuristic (file count, file:line presence, evidence-text patterns, unsafe/strategic keywords, force-external categories) + resurrection check against the regression ledger. Build-WaggleAutoRepairPrompt produces a tightly-constrained repair prompt with all 11 hard rules + an explicit SCOPE LIMIT clause + a repair_escalated.txt instruction for overflow. Test-FindingClassifier covers all four classes plus the heuristic + resurrection paths.

rows.title: Internal Claude review schema enhancement: reviewer_self_id + suggested_next_actions[]
rows.notes: Promoted to 'fixed' in Phase 2B-Revision P12. Both new fields are OPTIONAL on the Phase 2A-2 internal review schema; old reviews still validate. The validator enforces required sub-fields when reviewer_self_id is present, requires runtime='claude_code' for internal reviews, and validates estimated_effort enum on each suggested_next_action. The three internal review prompt templates request both blocks under a 'Phase 2B-Revision (SEC-009)' section. Test-ReviewSchema covers old/new/malformed shapes; Test-ReviewAdapter asserts the prompt files request both blocks.

rows.title: Redactor SHA-context allowlist does not survive JSON-encoded diff_text strings
rows.notes:
P9 architect review of PR #94 found that GIT_LOG_LINE only matched at line-start (?im)^commit\s+<sha>, which never fires inside a JSON-encoded string where '
' is the literal two-char escape. Phase 2BR2 P2 added a sibling rule GIT_LOG_LINE_JSON_ESC matching '
' or '
' preceding 'commit <hex40>'. New regression tests in Test-Redactor.ps1 (ARCH-001a..d) cover: 40-hex SHA inside JSON-escaped diff_text preserved; PR commit SHA in git_metadata.json preserved; PR commit SHA inside JSON-escaped diff_text preserved; SHA preserved AND inline secret redacted in same blob. Test-Redactor count: 27 -> 37.

rows.title: Redactor AWS_SECRET_KEY pattern eats long PowerShell identifiers
rows.notes: P9 architect review of PR #94 found the prior pattern (?<![A-Za-z0-9/+=])[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40}(?![A-Za-z0-9/+=]) accepted any 40-char run from the AWS class, including pure-alpha PowerShell function names like 'Add-WaggleRegressionFromHardeningGateFailure'. Phase 2BR2 P2 tightened the pattern with two zero-width lookaheads requiring at least one digit AND at least one of '/+=' inside the 40-char window. Real AWS secret-access-key shapes still match. Bonus side effect: pure-hex 40-runs (commit SHAs) no longer trip the AWS rule even outside SHA-context positions, so the GitShaContext rules become defence-in-depth rather than load-bearing. New regression tests in Test-Redactor.ps1 (ARCH-002a..c) cover: 40+ alpha PS identifier preserved; real AWS-shape redacted in env context; pure-hex 40-run not eaten.

rows.title: review_cockpit.html lives at repo root with no containing layer
rows.notes: P9 architect review of PR #94 noted the HTML cockpit at the repo root blurred the orchestrator's clean entry-points / lib / schemas / prompts boundary structure. Phase 2BR2 P3 git-mv'd review_cockpit.html under orchestrator/cockpit/, added orchestrator/cockpit/README.md describing the cockpit_data.json contract + 5s polling + origin allowlist, and updated Open-WaggleCockpit.ps1 to resolve the new path with a backward-compat fallback to the legacy repo-root location for in-flight worktrees. Test-CockpitData adds three new assertions: cockpit file exists at orchestrator/cockpit/, legacy repo-root cockpit removed, README exists. Test-CockpitData count: 30 -> 32.

rows.title: Dual-ledger contract (phase_fix_ledger vs regression_ledger) is implicit
rows.notes: P9 architect review of PR #94 noted phase_fix_ledger.json (committed) and state/regression_ledger.json (gitignored runtime) had overlapping conceptual surface but no documented contract. Phase 2BR2 P4 added docs/design/ledger_contract.md stating: phase_fix_ledger = committed historical record; regression_ledger = live runtime state machine; cross-link rules used by Build-WaggleProposalMatrix; what survives a clean clone; when to write where. The contract doc is referenced by both schemas via the 'See also' footer. Doc-only; no test added (phase_fix_ledger row anchor + ledger_contract.md presence is the proof).

rows.title: Invoke-WaggleReview top-level CLI dereferences $r.role on -DryRun pscustomobject which lacks role
rows.notes: Found in Phase 2B-R1 P9 while priming the architect self-review with a -DryRun shape check. The DryRun branch returned a pscustomobject WITHOUT 'role' or 'target_iteration_id'; the top-level CLI wrapper at the bottom of the script does Write-Host (...$r.role, $r.target_iteration_id, ...) under StrictMode in BOTH success and failure paths, which throws PropertyNotFoundStrict. Phase 2B-R1 (P10) routed this EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED / fixability_ambiguous because the proposed-fix string offered multiple shapes; recorded as backlog. Phase 2B-R2 P5 reproduced via direct dry-run invocation (Test-ReviewRunner) and confirmed the cleanest fix is to make the DryRun return object carry the same identity fields ('role', 'target_iteration_id', 'status') as the non-DryRun branch. New assertions in Test-ReviewRunner.ps1 ('dry-run: returns role property', 'dry-run: returns target_iteration_id property', 'dry-run: returns status property') lock this in. Test count: 69 -> 72.
